Opposite Party :- State Of Up And 3 Others Counsel for Revisionist :- Kamlesh Kumar Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Learned counsel for the revisionist is directed to correct the name of opposite party no. 2 during the course of the day.
Supplementary affidavit filed today by learned counsel for the revisionist is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the revisionist as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material on record.

The present criminal revision has been preferred by the revisionist under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C. to set aside the order dated 12.12.2023 passed by Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge, POCSO Court, Ghazipur in Special Sessions Trial No. 97 of 2015 (State Vs. sentences.text:
It is submitted by learned counsel for the revisionist that in this case the informant lodged an F.I.R.
against the co-accused Bablu and the present opposite party no. 2-Anil with allegation that they enticed away his daughter Arti, but during the course of investigation name of Anil was exonerated.

During trial, statement of P.W.-I (informant/father of the victim), P.W.-2 (mother of the victim) and P.W.-3 (victim herself) have been recorded, in which the complicity of opposite party no. 2-Anil was also disclosed and found established regarding which an application under Section 319 Cr.P.C. has been moved for summoning co-accused Anil, but it was rejected by learned court without considering the facts and statements of the witnesses as recorded before the learned trial court,
therefore, request to set it aside the order passed by learned court concerned dated 12.12.2023 and summon the opposite party no. 2 for trial.

Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid and contended that in this case though the name of present opposite party no. 2 was mentioned in the F.I.R. for assisting the co-accused Bablu in enticement of daughter of the informant, but during trial the statement of the victim herself was recorded in which she did not state that he was involved in the incident, therefore, learned court has not allowed the application.
It cannot be said to be illegal, but this revision being devoid of merit is liable to be dismissed.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of record, order passed by learned trial court and the statement of the witnesses particularly the statement of the victim herself recorded as P.W.-3, it appears that during cross-examination she stated clearly that she knew opposite party no. 2 who belongs to his community.
He did not come to her house.
He did not go to Hyderabad with her, but he was Bablu.
When she became conscious, there was only Bablu.
She also stated that how she arrived at Hyderabad is unknown to her.
She also expressed inability in remembering as to whether she became unconscious by smelling something by Anil or some other person.
In this way, the complicity of opposite party no. 2 cannot be said to be established, as a result powers under Section 319 Cr.P.C. cannot be exercised for summoning him to face the trial.

Learned trial court has passed the order in question after considering all the facts of the case, which cannot be said to be illegal or improper, but this revision being devoid of merit is liable to be dismissed.
Accordingly, the present revision is dismissed.
